extraction_notes: The EAR portal serves this CCR only as a Word .docx (saved as reports/CA4300994/ccr-2025.docx, format docx); paragraphs and tables were read from word/document.xml with python3 -I, so 'pages' and per-row 'page' are null (the cached header field reads 'Page 5 of 9'). State SWS CCR template prepared by Cypress Water Services (Report Date 5/1/2026, monitoring period January 1 to December 31, 2025); the report calls the system 'Coyote Valley RV'. Several results are older than the data year (barium, fluoride, nickel, iron, manganese, odor and turbidity 10/12/2022; hexavalent chromium 11/12/2024; TTHM 8/13/2024); sample_year records the printed date. Table 6 (unregulated) is printed 'None'. The Combined Radium PHG cell is garbled ('(0)4'). The Color row has no unit. Most rows print range 'NA' and use value_basis 'level detected'; nitrate (two 2025 samples with a range) is stored as an average.
